assets.body:
Purpose: prepare a traceable reconstruction contract and invoke a qualified editable-CAD producer only after Wright's gates pass. These are logical bindings to existing Wright artifacts, not a new wire schema.
Inputs: claim contract; typed requirements; evidence index; authorized hypothesis ranges; qualified-capability records; immutable run manifest; native/export contracts. Required model settings are gpt-6-astra/high on every observed model request, enforced on the existing invocation path.
1. Verify instruction snapshot and artifact hashes, object revision/configuration, evidence rights, requirement authority, units/datums and source-role partitions. Do not infer absent project requirements from public architecture or examples. Return input_required for missing necessary choices; capability_unavailable for a missing qualified producer or enforcement path.
2. Build a requirement-to-observation-to-parameter map. Identify visible constraints, occlusions, depth/scale ambiguity and conflicting evidence. Keep measured/published/calculated/inferred/assumed/unknown classifications distinct. List formulas, input IDs, correlations and uncertainty. Do not convert an unsupported hidden feature into a verified dimension.
3. Select methods within their qualified scope. Preserve source camera/crop/distortion lineage. Treat learned geometry only as a labeled hypothesis. Do not optimize audit cameras, masks, scale or reference identities to favor the candidate.
4. Obtain a frozen manifest through Wright before production. Use a qualified producer and record exact observable requests with existing redaction, producer/version, input identities, operation identity and output hashes. A prompt describing CAD generation does not establish producer capability.
5. Deliver native editable CAD and authorized exports. Record feature/parameter names, units, editability evidence, topology/intent limitations and export transformations. Distinguish a reference mesh from a native editable model. No manufacturing or functional claim follows merely from geometric resemblance.
6. Emit EngineeringResult-compatible results and provenance: claim_contract, evidence_index, requirement_ledger, observability_map, frozen_manifest, native_cad, export_manifest and unknowns_report. Use existing Wright adapters rather than claiming these identifiers are already implemented fields. Include per-output revision and hashes.
7. Stop on hash/state mismatch, missing required input/capability, uncertain mutation, forbidden model drift or a configured execution/storage bound. Do not replay uncertain writes or silently change providers. Route declared review to Wright; do not simulate approval.

Purpose: measure the exact candidate and exports, not a convenient preview or stale model.
Inputs: frozen manifest; requirement/profile/reference identities; candidate/native/export hashes; calibrated observations and source groups; applicable executable method qualification; declared uncertainty and acceptance rules.
1. Verify all identities and hashes before reading geometry for scoring. Resolve units, frame, datums, scale and transformations explicitly. Reject wrong revision, wrong camera or changed bytes; never silently realign or rescale to improve results. If registration is permitted, its degrees of freedom, fitting evidence, objective and uncertainty must already be declared. Do not fit scale when scale is under test.
2. Projection: render/project the exact geometry through frozen calibrated cameras, distortion and crop/resize transforms in a declared image-coordinate convention. Compare silhouettes with the declared overlap/boundary metrics and landmarks with declared residuals and weights. Report visible support, segmentation/calibration uncertainty and exclusions. Gloss, glass and occlusion may make an apparent boundary invalid; mark such observations uncertain or unusable.
3. Dimensions/sections: measure named features, datum relationships and sections at declared planes against authoritative requirements. Record measured quantities, units and residuals. Use drawing dimensions according to their authority; do not substitute pixel-derived estimates where drawing scale is unqualified.
4. Surface comparison: when an independent 3D reference exists, compute candidate-to-reference and reference-to-candidate distances with declared alignment, sampling/area weighting, coverage, outlier handling and summary statistics. Preserve both directions so missing regions and spurious additions are exposed. Do not present distances to an inferred mesh as independent ground truth.
5. Uncertainty: propagate input uncertainty and correlations through calculations using the declared applicable method. Include source, calibration, scale, segmentation, reference, discretization and registration contributions where relevant. Report absent uncertainty information and resulting claim limits. Apply only requirement-specific decision rules; return unknown/inconclusive rather than inventing tolerances or favorable guard bands. A silhouette pass does not verify hidden depth.
6. Keep geometry fidelity separate from CAD intent/topology and export integrity. Check native editability/topology using qualified checks. Independently reopen exact exported bytes with a qualified reader and verify declared units/frame, supported entities and native-to-export agreement under supplied rules. Optional manufacturing checks run only with supplied requirements and qualified tools.
7. Development measurements may guide correction. Audit measurements must use reserved independent source groups and candidate-independent frozen cameras and references, with a verifier not responsible for candidate production or tuning. Report residual shared-source dependencies; a second tool alone is not evidence independence. Do not use audit feedback for an undisclosed fitting loop.
Outputs: measurement_report with per-requirement disposition, values, uncertainty, coverage and provenance; native_intent_report; exact_export_report; optional manufacturing_report; independent_audit_report when its gate is met. Report tool failure separately from engineering failure. Required missing tools hold their dependent results. Every result binds to exact artifact, reference, instruction and profile revisions.

Purpose: perform bounded, traceable rework of named parameters only.
Required configuration supplied before unattended operation: allowed parameter IDs, units, bounds and coupling constraints; protected requirements; development objective and aggregation rule; uncertainty-aware minimum meaningful improvement and non-improvement window; maximum correction attempts and execution/storage bounds; authorized rollback behavior. Missing choices are input_required, not an invitation to choose convenient defaults.
1. Confirm the exact parent revision, development measurement identities, remaining budget, qualified producer and gpt-6-astra/high request guard. Do not inspect reserved audit results for optimization.
2. Propose an explicit parameter delta and predicted affected requirements. Reject edits to unnamed parameters, topology beyond authorized parameter behavior, evidence, calibration, cameras, masks, scale anchors, datums, requirements, tolerance/profile/reference identities or holdout membership. Such changes require a separately declared revision and requalification/invalidation path, not this correction loop.
3. Invoke the producer once through the durable runtime using its operation identity. Record before/after values, rationale, actual observable request, candidate hashes and provenance. On uncertain mutation, reconcile; do not blindly retry. Count dispatched attempts against the declared budget even when they fail, according to the supplied accounting rule; uncertainty never resets the budget.
4. Re-export and remeasure the exact new revision, including export integrity and protected requirements. Evaluate improvement against the frozen objective, uncertainty rule and non-improvement window. Do not substitute subjective visual preference for the supplied rule.
5. Stop when applicable development criteria are met, the correction/compute/storage budget is exhausted, non-improvement reaches its configured stop, protected constraints regress without an authorized recovery, the feasible parameter bounds cannot support the requirements, a required capability/input is missing, model drift is detected or a mutation outcome remains uncertain. Report the stop reason and unresolved requirements. Never silently enlarge the budget.
6. Retain all revision lineage. Select or restore a prior candidate only under the supplied selection/rollback rule; never rewrite history or transfer old audit approval. Submit the final exact candidate to the independent audit gate. Audit failure produces a report and declared rework decision; it is not permission to optimize against the same holdout.
Outputs: correction_log, parameter_deltas, revision_lineage, stop_report and candidate_for_audit. Human acceptance remains a separate Wright review.
